verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents plugin marketplaces as catalogs for distributing plugins, with centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates, and git-repo or local-path sources; anyone with access registers one with a single command and installs from it. Plugins bundling skills are documented as shareable across projects and teams, project-level `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` paths are documented, and API skills can be private to a workspace. A hands-on probe confirmed installing an official skill from the repo into a project's `./.claude/skills/` directory, and the official repo itself registers as a marketplace. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs stating that committing `.claude/skills` to a repo shares skills with teammates, and evidence of admin-enforced team rollout of skills.
